pricing.contribute

Function to send OffStream contribution request.

Available as lseg.data.content.pricing.contribute.

contribute(
    name: str,
    fields: dict,
    *,
    service: OptStr = None,
    contrib_type: str | ContribType | None = None,
    session: Session = None,
    api: OptStr = None,
    on_ack: OptCall = None,
    on_error: OptCall = None,
) -> ContribResponse

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
name str Yes RIC to retrieve instrument stream.
fields dict Yes Specify fields and values to contribute.
service OptStr No None Specify the service to contribute on. Default: None
contrib_type str | ContribType | None No None Define the contribution type : ["Refresh", "Update"] Default: "Update"
session Session No None Specify the session used to contribute
api OptStr No None specific name of contrib streaming defined in config file. i.e. 'streaming.pricing.endpoints.my_server' Default: 'streaming.pricing.endpoints.main'
on_ack OptCall No None Callback function for on_ack event to check contribution result
on_error OptCall No None Callback function for on_error event

Returns

ContribResponse

Example

# Prerequisite: The contrib_session must be opened

import lseg.data as ld
def on_ack_callback(ack_msg, stream):
    print("Receive Ack response:", ack_msg)
def on_error_callback(error_msg, stream):
    print("Receive Error:", error_msg)
update = {
    "ASK": 1.23,
    "BID": 1.24
}
response = ld.delivery.omm_stream.contribute(
    name="EUR=",
    fields=update,
    service="SVC_CONTRIB",
    on_ack=on_ack_callback,
    on_error=on_error_callback
)
